reviews.review:
one of my favorite games, its got great replay ability with a good challenge. each run is different and it doesn't hand hold you. i look forward to more content and characters being added. love some of the crazy builds and never thought the sound of pinballs would bring me such joy. 

this game makes my hands sweaty.

I'm not rogue-like gamer, but this was so fun to play with my boyfriend (I got carried).  We jumped in with normal and decided we'd just play on easy, which was still kinda difficult for me especially at the start when I didn't understand the upgrades.  As much as I love repetitive games, I would love to see different game types or more playable characters or be able to customise how my character looks a little bit more (I know there are those colour upgrades) - Having to find Croaks was cool because it gave me something else to look for other than the objectives and I think I'd like more things like that.  Definitely going to get the rest of the homies to play this - even though they suggested it first, I think they'd love it.

Pros: You get to have fun with friends and the powerups are basically RNG so you could be getting 4 legendary tier power-ups on first run or you could get just purely common power-ups on first run. You can do easy, normal, and hard runs. There's plentiful large place to explore with friends and stuff, can be fun for solo run to see if you can win gg or fail miserably. Heroes and their weapons are pretty fun to play with.

Cons: Insufficient content. There's a big lack in power-ups and there's only one game mode at the moment. There's no endless run, boss battle, difficulty sliders/box ticks (like slay the spire where you have all the options enabled for randomizer, etc.). Game gets stale very fast over time since there's really nothing new and there's not much to do once you get all achievements.

--

Currently waiting for an update to get more rune upgrades, more fun power-ups, new hero, and other fun stuff. Hopefully more new game modes will come out as suggested.

Long story short, don't buy it if you don't really want short lacking contents, buy it if you like the gameplay style and you'd play with friends (or solo) while you love this kinda game mode even if there's not much contents.

I played for 24 hours, but only the first 4 were really fun.

It feels like the developers didn’t properly test the Normal and Hard difficulty modes. Easy is far too simple, Normal already relies heavily on luck and anticipation, and Hard is just frustrating. I completed Easy and Normal solo, but in both Normal and Hard, defeating the second boss feels more dependent on luck (or using exploits like jumping over the wall and shooting) than actual skill.

The bosses are a mixed bag. The first boss is excellent, the third is very easy (only three attack patterns but a huge amount of HP), and the fourth is also well-designed—challenging, but fair.

The day/night system is a great idea, but it doesn’t hold up on the final map. The sniper enemy can hit you about two seconds after the red light appears, and at night they spawn in groups of four or five, which often leads to instant death. Surviving the night becomes nearly impossible—reducing the sniper spawn rate would greatly improve the experience.

Finally, the merchant spawn rate on the last map feels completely unbalanced. In several runs, I only found two merchants across the entire map. When you’re sitting on 20,000 gold and items cost around 2,000, it just becomes frustrating not being able to spend your resources.

Overall, the game has good ideas, but it really needs better balancing.
